en.headline: Download and install updates in the app
notes: Packaged Windows builds can download an update in the app and show its progress.
The downloaded executable is verified against the release SHA-256 before installation.
The app closes and restarts to apply the update. A backup is kept and restored if the new build cannot start.
Older versions need one manual install before they can use in-app downloading and installation.

zh.headline: 在应用中下载并安装更新
notes: Windows 安装版现在可以直接在应用中下载更新并显示进度。
安装前会使用发布清单中的 SHA-256 校验下载的程序。
应用会关闭并重新启动以完成更新。如果新版本无法启动，会保留并恢复旧版本。
旧版本需要先手动安装一次，之后才能使用应用内下载和安装。
